text: Which letter of the alphabet is the 18th?
why: A-I is 9, J-R takes you to 18: R.

text: Count the Es in the word EXCELLENCE.
Fold a sheet of paper in half, then in half again, four folds in all. How many layers thick is it?
Kim is fourth from the front of a queue and fourth from the back. How many people are queuing?
why: Three in front of Kim, three behind, and Kim: seven.

text: A fortnight lasts how many minutes?
Gran is 80 and her grandson is 8. In how many years will Gran be exactly five times his age?
why: In 10 years she'll be 90 and he'll be 18, and 18 × 5 = 90.

text: With three straight cuts across a round pizza, what is the most pieces you can make?
why: Make every cut cross both of the others, and not all at one point: 7 pieces.
